title: consistent not uniform
rule: Consistent, not uniform — same behaviour for common components; services may apply their own colour, type, sub-logo, and flows without disrupting the shared default.
pass_when: Shared components keep the same behaviour; service colour/type/sub-logo/flow differences do not change that default behaviour.
fail_when: A service restyles a common control so its behaviour no longer matches the shared default.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Visual loudness / one-primary as this principle; a house brand-token set.
